query:
When Nadia proposed a dedicated full-group critique session, what did the group decide -- and who objected to the original format?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Reuben
C. Simone
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t13 @2026-08-23T09:54:00) okay so here's the thing -- September booking is sorted. I also want to plan the autumn properly this year: one session a month September through December, plus I want to organise a proper group critique session in October. I think we are at a point where the work warrants it. 📅
[2] (about=Reuben, episodic, t14 @2026-08-23T09:57:00) September works. October I'd rather keep the making time intact. A full critique session only makes sense if people are bringing work that's ready. I've never found the conversation useful unless the pieces are genuinely done.
[3] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-23T10:04:00) fair enough, Reuben -- I'll circulate the date and we can see how many finished pieces the group has by then. if the work isn't ready the session can stay as working time. what I won't do is cancel the booking because we might not have enough pieces. 😄
[4] (about=Reuben, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:49:00) I would prefer to keep making time separate. A critique session is fine but I don't want to spend three hours just talking. Maybe last forty minutes of the session.
[5] (about=Callum, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:46:00) I am in favour. Having something structured to work toward helps, assuming we get enough pieces ready in time. I would rather have a proper critique than an improvised one.
[6] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:53:00) okay fair enough, last forty minutes it is. I'll plan accordingly -- bring a finished or near-finished piece if you want it in the round. no pressure. 🙌
[7] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:42:00) okay so here's the thing, I've been thinking about doing a group critique session properly in March -- not just a quick chat but a proper round of feedback. I'm wondering if we should do it as the main activity rather than alongside throwing. thoughts? I can set it up properly -- printed notes, the whole thing. 📋
[8] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:09:00) so how did everyone feel about today's session? I want to do a very informal critique if people are open to it -- not a whole structured thing, just a quick round-table on what worked, what didn't. put your piece on the table if you want feedback. totally optional, just the five of us. 🎨
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-23T10:32:00) okay so here's the thing -- I want to keep this going properly into the autumn. I've been doing this group for three years and it keeps being the thing in my week that I don't compromise on. the work has got better, the conversations have got better, and even Yuki talks now. small miracle. 😄
[10] (about=Simone, episodic, t12 @2026-07-19T09:54:00) I literally could not have made that bowl without you Nadia
agent_answer: Reuben objected to the original format.

query:
When Nadia raised the possibility of inviting a new member to the group, what was the group's response -- and was there someone who disagreed with her framing?

Options:
A. Simone
B. Yuki
C. Reuben
D. Nadia
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t10 @2026-06-14T10:05:00) okay, noted. right -- I also want to say, this is our first session without Callum and it feels a bit quiet. I might look into whether we should invite someone else to join. not to replace him, just to keep the group energy going. thoughts? no pressure, just raising it. 🤔
[2] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2026-06-14T10:10:00) I actually think someone newer could be great?? I was a beginner when I joined and look at me now 😂 but yeah I see what Reuben means about keeping it serious
[3] (about=Nadia, episodic, t10 @2026-06-14T10:13:00) fair enough, I'll think about it. I have someone in mind from the open day -- they do hand-building, been going about three years. I'll mention it after we see their work in the show. no commitments yet. anyway -- what is everyone working on today? I want to get into my new series, three tall cylinders thrown already. 🔥
[4] (about=Yuki, episodic, t10 @2026-06-14T10:03:00) No.
[5] (about=Reuben, episodic, t10 @2026-06-14T10:40:00) By the way -- has anyone heard from Callum since the farewell session?
[6] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-23T10:32:00) okay so here's the thing -- I want to keep this going properly into the autumn. I've been doing this group for three years and it keeps being the thing in my week that I don't compromise on. the work has got better, the conversations have got better, and even Yuki talks now. small miracle. 😄
[7] (about=Simone, episodic, t12 @2026-07-19T09:54:00) I literally could not have made that bowl without you Nadia
[8] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-23T10:25:00) Yuki, I had no idea. I'm really glad you stayed. 🤍
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t4 @2026-03-15T10:51:00) I'm in 🌿
[10] (about=Yuki, episodic, t14 @2026-08-23T10:21:00) I want to say something. I almost did not join this group.
agent_answer:
Based on the raw excerpts:

- **Nadia** raised the idea of inviting someone new, framing it as "not to replace him, just to keep the group energy going."
- **Simone** was enthusiastic ("someone newer could be great??") but noted Reuben's concern about keeping the group serious.
- **Reuben** (via Simone's remark: "I see what Reuben means about keeping it serious") was the one who expressed caution / disagreed with the casual framing.
- **Yuki** has no recorded response on this topic.

The person who disagreed with Nadia's framing was **Reuben** (option **C**).
